gui.setup.2: Teams and players at the merge
gui.testing.1: Creates fake participants (Test1, Test2...) to try teams, the draw and the merge without other players.
gui.council.3: Start a council for a team
gui.finale.1: 3 players left → poles challenge → the winner picks an opponent → anonymous jury vote → reveal.
gui.spawns.1: Points are set at your position. Special ones: conseil, elimination, jury.
gui.title: Cosmic Island - Administration
gui.field.name: name
food.err.empty: Hold the item in your main hand.

food.list.title: Food thirst rules: %s item(s), %s tag(s)
gui.food.1: Hold a food or drink (from another mod too) in your main hand, then set its effect on thirst. Tags (forge:raw_fishes, forge:fruits...) set all matching items at once.
sim.help: &6[Simulation] &7/ccis season simulate run [players] [teams] [merge] plays a full season with fake players (Test1...). &cWARNING: this resets the season and the log.&7 Use a test world. Cleanup: /ccis season simulate stop.
sim.err.params: Invalid parameters: %s players, %s teams, merge at %s (the merge needs 4 or more players, fewer than the player count).
sim.err.real: A real participant is registered (%s): the simulation would change them. Roles are shared by all worlds (config/cosmicisland/players.json). Remove them with /ccis role set %s organizer, then run again.
sim.start: &6[Simulation] &7%s players, %s teams, merge at %s players: expected jury of &f%s&7.
sim.cleaned: &6[Simulation] &7Cleaned: fake players, jury and season reset (created teams remain).
sim.reveal: &6[Simulation] &7Reveal started: watch the tally. Then clean up with /ccis season simulate stop.
sim.chk.players: Fake participants created: %s out of %s expected.
sim.chk.merge: Merge triggered at %s players, phase "after merge".
sim.chk.jury: The jury (%s) is exactly the set of players eliminated after the merge (%s expected).
sim.chk.premerge: None of the %s players eliminated before the merge is in the jury.
sim.chk.excluded: %s (not chosen for the finale) is not in the jury.
sim.chk.finalists: The 2 finalists are the poles winner and their opponent.
sim.chk.odd: The jury is odd (%s): no tie possible.
sim.chk.votes: One vote per juror: %s votes for %s jurors.
sim.chk.size: Jury size %s = players at the merge - 3 (%s).
gui.testing.5: Plays a whole season with fake players, using the real commands, then checks the rules (jury, finale, votes). Resets the season and the log: use a test world.
